source.name: AFC - Venues confirmed for ACL Elite Finals Jeddah 2026
source.note: King Abdullah Sports City and Prince Abdullah Al Faisal Sports City, Jeddah, host the finals 16-25 April 2026, as in 2025.

note: The centralised finals are hosted in Saudi Arabia; the 'provisionally through 2029' term comes from the Wikipedia season article and is unconfirmed by an AFC page. Recorded as the Saudi state as host; Visit Saudi is the state's tourism platform.
